title: CLEAN WEBOS
subtitle: Guided setup for your LG TV
test: TEST — Read-only checks, no changes to the TV
continue: ENTER next  •  B back  •  Q quit
ip_help: Enter the TV IPv4 in the terminal after the menu, if required
bad_ip: TV address required. Use --ip 192.168.1.24 or text mode.
root_missing: Root SSH unavailable. Check Homebrew Root status and enable SSH first.
root_yes: Does Homebrew Channel already show Root status OK?
root_needed: If not rooted, SlopBro is an OPTIONAL community exploit by throwaway96 (AGPL-3.0-or-later).
root_risk: The root procedure can change system services or cause loss of data; no firmware compatibility is guaranteed.
root_credits: Many thanks to throwaway96 and the contributors to SlopBro, jsbro-autoroot and webOS Homebrew.
root_next: After SlopBro: verify Root OK, uninstall official LG Developer Mode before reboot, then enable SSH. Do not restart before checking.
homebrew_present: Homebrew Channel detected. Do not reinstall.
homebrew_absent: Homebrew Channel not confirmed; the official installer will be offered only in APPLY mode.
root_skip: Skipping exploit. No root access obtained.
port_telnet: WARNING: Telnet port 23 is open. Disable it in Homebrew once secure SSH is working.
guide_mapper: Open LG Input Hook at least once. Add keybind, press the remote key, read its key ID in Logs and choose the target. Save changes.
guide_aerial: Open Aerial, choose the video source/resolution, enable Autostart, press Apply, then Test screensaver. Avoid two active screen-saver overrides.
guide_ads: Ad Killer uses only the reversible ads profile. It hides ads/recommendations, may require Home reload, and has a Restore option.
guide_glass: Glasshouse offers an app inventory, system tile hiding, background services and remote mapping. Configure an API token; NEVER expose its port 8080 to the internet.
guide_system: System apps are HIDDEN, not deleted. Experimental in Glasshouse: enable Tile Hiding before selecting apps, never hide core TV functionality.
guide_apps: Only verified removable apps can be uninstalled with explicit confirmation. Homebrew, Jellyfin and critical system apps are protected.
guide_youtube: YouTube AdFree shares an app ID with official YouTube. Never replace the official app silently.
guide_complete: No firmware update blocking is performed. Avoid exposing SSH or web dashboards to the internet.
module_mapper: LG Input Hook — Remap remote shortcut keys
module_aerial: Aerial — Apple TV style moving screensaver
module_ads: Ad blocker — Remove LG Home promotions (reversible)
module_system: System apps — List and hide/unhide icons
module_apps: Installed apps — List and uninstall removable apps
fail_check: Read-only verification could not confirm this feature; no change made.
module_services: Background services — Disable/restore optional LG services
guide_services: Glasshouse lists only vetted optional services. Disabling may break diagnostics, voice-like features, or accessories; each selection is reversible.
ssh_default_password: Initial Homebrew root password: alpine, until SSH authorized keys are installed. This password may have been changed; use a key afterward.
